WITH filtered_titles AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    WHERE t.production_year > 2000
      AND (t.title LIKE '%Freddy%' OR t.title LIKE '%Jason%' OR t.title LIKE 'Saw%')
),
male_writers AS (
    SELECT ci.movie_id, n.name
    FROM cast_info AS ci
    JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
    WHERE ci.note IN ('(writer)', '(head writer)', '(written by)', '(story)', '(story editor)')
      AND n.gender = 'm'
),
lionsgate_bluray AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE cn.name LIKE 'Lionsgate%'
      AND mc.note LIKE '%(Blu-ray)%'
),
genre_movie_info AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id, mi.info
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN info_type AS it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE it1.info = 'genres'
      AND mi.info IN ('Horror', 'Thriller')
),
votes_movie_info_idx AS (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id, mi_idx.info
    FROM movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
    JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
    WHERE it2.info = 'votes'
),
matching_keywords AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword IN ('murder', 'violence', 'blood', 'gore', 'death', 'female-nudity', 'hospital')
)
SELECT MIN(genre_movie_info.info) AS movie_budget,
       MIN(votes_movie_info_idx.info) AS movie_votes,
       MIN(male_writers.name) AS writer,
       MIN(t.title) AS violent_liongate_movie
FROM filtered_titles AS t
JOIN male_writers ON male_writers.movie_id = t.id
JOIN lionsgate_bluray ON lionsgate_bluray.movie_id = t.id
JOIN genre_movie_info ON genre_movie_info.movie_id = t.id
JOIN votes_movie_info_idx ON votes_movie_info_idx.movie_id = t.id
JOIN matching_keywords ON matching_keywords.movie_id = t.id
